title: ECLIPTICA -- A Framework for Switchable LLM Alignment via CITA - Contrastive Instruction-Tuned Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2601.06157v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Alignment in large language models (LLMs) is still largely static: after training, the policy is frozen. DPO, GRPO methods typically imprint one behavior into the weights, leaving little runtime control beyond prompt hacks or expensive re-alignment. We introduce ECLIPTICA, which treats alignment as instruction-driven and runtime-controllable: natural-language alignment instructions act as an explicit behavioral contract (stance, refusal boundary, verbosity) that modulates behavior on the fly under evolving safety requirements, user roles, and governance constraints.   We introduce CITA (Contrastive Instruction-Tuned Alignment), combining SFT with contrastive preference optimization under an explicit geometric anchor to a reference model. translated_title: ECLIPTICA——一个通过CITA（对比指令微调对齐）实现可切换LLM对齐的框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的对齐在很大程度上仍然是静态的：训练完成后，策略即被冻结。DPO、GRPO等方法通常将一种行为固化到模型权重中，除了提示词技巧或昂贵的重新对齐之外，几乎无法提供运行时控制。我们提出了ECLIPTICA，它将对齐视为指令驱动且运行时可控的：自然语言对齐指令充当明确的行为契约（立场、拒绝边界、回答详细程度），在安全要求、用户角色和治理约束不断演变的情况下，实时调控行为。我们提出了CITA（对比指令微调对齐），在显式的参考模型几何锚定下，将SFT与对比偏好优化相结合。这产生了一个稳定的黎曼坐标系，并将指令更新保持在共享邻域内，使各行为模式保持邻近且可遍历，从而实现可靠的切换。为了隔离策略切换……
tldr: 提出ECLIPTICA框架及CITA方法，通过将SFT与对比偏好优化结合并锚定参考模型几何结构，使大语言模型的对齐行为可在运行时通过自然语言指令灵活切换和控制。
en_tdlr: ECLIPTICA introduces CITA, which combines SFT with contrastive preference optimization under a geometric anchor to a reference model, enabling runtime-switchable LLM alignment driven by natural-language instructions.
